PROJECTS
 QuickCrave — AI-Powered Real-Time Food Delivery Platform [ Live Project ]
Designed and developed a scalable food delivery platform with real-time GPS tracking and WebSocket-based
communication. Implemented Redis caching and backend optimizations to improve application performance and
reliability under concurrent workloads. Built a conversational ordering system secured with JWT authentication,
enabling users to browse menus, place orders, and track deliveries in real time. Developed features such as
role-based access control, ETA prediction, heartbeat monitoring, and automated order lifecycle management
using an event-driven architecture.
 Scatch — Scalable E-Commerce Platform [ Live Project ]
Developed a full-stack e-commerce platform with secure authentication, payment integration, product filtering,
and checkout workflows. Built admin modules for product management, coupon handling, order tracking, and
image uploads with role-based access control. Designed and integrated RESTful APIs and optimized database
interactions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability while enhancing user experience.
 TaskFlow — Collaborative Project & Workflow Management System [ Live Project ]
Developed a collaborative project management platform featuring Kanban boards, task assignments, file
attachments, deadlines, and project-level permissions. Implemented real-time notifications, comments, and
activity feeds using Socket.io and an event-driven architecture for team collaboration. Designed synchronization
mechanisms to support concurrent users and maintain data consistency across real-time interactions.
